visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a grey t-shirt and tan pants sits outdoors on a black equipment case in a green grassy field. In front of him is a black table holding a large battery pack, several small bottles, and gear. Behind him, a silver SUV has its rear hatch open, revealing more equipment. He holds a folded white plastic sheet and looks toward the camera. (2) The man unfolds the large, translucent white plastic sheet, shaking it out to display its size. The background remains the same, with trees and a clear sky in the distance. He gestures with his hands toward the sheet on the grass. (3) The man holds two small green packaged items toward the camera. (4) He opens a green package and pulls out a thin, dark green foil-like material. He begins unfolding the large green sheet, showing the silver reflective side. (5) The man is shown wearing the green and silver material over his head like a hood, with the material draped over his shoulders as a poncho. (6) Back at the table, he holds a small brown camouflage pouch. He opens it and pulls out a camouflage-patterned fabric. (7) He unfolds a very large tube-shaped item that is camouflage on the outside and silver on the inside. He holds it up to demonstrate its length and width, showing it can fit a person. (8) He pulls a large green camouflage item out of a matching compression bag. He spreads the thick, quilted material out over the table and ground sheet. (9) The man is shown wearing the large camouflage quilted item over his head and shoulders, fastened like a heavy cloak.
